messages.title: Full text
messages.text:
Father we thank You for it has pleased You
By the eternal law of confession and utterance
To set the direction of our lives
This day again
We set the course of our lives
With the rudder of our mouth

Toward peace, joy, faith and progress
Citizens of Light Church is a city set on a hill
And we can’t be hidden
We are a lighthouse to the nations

In this house there is transformation
In this house there is hope
A small one has become a thousand
And there is no weakling in our midst
Our trajectory is forward and upward only in Jesus Name
Every son and daughter of this family
Has come into the fullness of God’s purpose and will for their lives
We are in our path of ordination and preordination and we do not depart.
In all our services
The sick are healed
The poor are made rich
The rejected have excelled

The grace of God is released to change situations
and create a supernatural turnaround for everyone

This is the house of the mighty
and we are the camp of the wealthy

Our homes are safe
Our properties are protected
Our journeys are blessed to and fro
As the ransomed of the Lord that we are
We have found favor with the old
The young, the familiar
And the strangers alike in Jesus Name
I boldly decree and declare
The kingdom of God is my priority
The desire of God is my pursuit
The pleasure of God is my passion
I love the Lord wholly with my heart
My resources, and strength

I live and not die
For God fulfills the number of my days
I live in health
I live in peace
I live in joy
I am a Citizen of the Kingdom of Light and Life
Therefore I live and shine as bright as the Sun
For my generation to see Jesus
Jesus is glorified through my life!!!

messages.title: Love Choices · Intro
messages.text:
Was It Love or Was It Me?
A heart-check moment is this God’s design or just my desire?
Today, we uncover the difference between true love and personal longing.
Today, we’re not just asking a question, we’re starting a conversation.
A conversation about love, choices, growth, and God who writes the best love stories.

We’re so excited to have you here! Truly, it’s amazing to see you in church today.
Welcome to Love Choices and Other Beautiful Words 2026 where hearts are open, minds are renewed, and lives are transformed.
Get ready,
It’s going to be real.
It’s going to be refreshing.
And most of all, it’s going to be an unforgettable time in God’s presence.
You’re in the right place. 💛

messages.title: Love Choices · Closing
messages.text:
As we close Love Choices and Other Beautiful Words 2026, don’t just leave with notes, leave with clarity, growth, and a heart aligned with God. May you never confuse love with loneliness or desire with destiny, but walk boldly in wisdom and truth. Thank you for showing up open and ready, go out wiser, go out confident, and most of all, go out loved. 💛

Our next service is on Wednesday, 26th of November, 2026 by 5:30pm, whether online or onsite.
WELCOME TO FREEDOM, SIRS AND MAS!!!
